about.changelog.assets.text: Asset Register with Physical Labels: Full OEM/warranty/lifecycle records, plus QR & DataMatrix label printing — offline payloads for Zebra or any sheet printer, no internet required.
about.changelog.assets.context: UI string for key about.changelog.assets (WCC CMMS).

about.changelog.design.text: Unified Design System: One token-driven look across every module — AA-contrast text, a single modal/button/badge family, true Light/Dark, and a WebGL background that can be switched off on older machines.
about.changelog.design.context: UI string for key about.changelog.design (WCC CMMS).

about.changelog.inventory.text: Inventory with a Real Ledger: Every movement — ticket consumption, work-order consumption, PO receipt — is recorded and traceable back to the job that caused it.
about.changelog.inventory.context: UI string for key about.changelog.inventory (WCC CMMS).

about.changelog.notif.text: Notifications & Audit Trail: Per-user alerts for approvals, low stock and overdue work, with an immutable audit log behind them.
about.changelog.notif.context: UI string for key about.changelog.notif (WCC CMMS).

about.changelog.procurement.text: Procurement, End to End: Requisition → cost approval → storekeeper fulfilment → goods receipt → budget reconciliation, with a nine-stage tracking stepper and full status history.
about.changelog.procurement.context: UI string for key about.changelog.procurement (WCC CMMS).

about.changelog.rbac.text: Granular RBAC: 22 permissions across 6 editable roles, enforced server-side on every page and API endpoint — including a Storekeeper who can fulfil orders but never approve their cost.
about.changelog.rbac.context: UI string for key about.changelog.rbac (WCC CMMS).

about.changelog.reorder.text: Event-Driven Auto-Reorder: Consumption that drops a part to its minimum raises a requisition automatically, through the same approval rules as a manual one.
about.changelog.reorder.context: UI string for key about.changelog.reorder (WCC CMMS).

about.changelog.security.text: Hardened by Default: CSRF on state changes, prepared statements throughout, session-fixation and brute-force defences, and Evil Maid locks binding takeover and closeout to the authenticated user.
about.changelog.security.context: UI string for key about.changelog.security (WCC CMMS).

about.changelog.tickets.text: Complete Ticket Lifecycle: Register → takeover → logged actions → closeout → searchable history, with time captured at every step so MTTA and MTTR are measured, not estimated.
about.changelog.tickets.context: UI string for key about.changelog.tickets (WCC CMMS).

about.changelog.ux.text: Device-Aware UX: Handheld mode activates automatically — tables collapse into cards, the calendar becomes an agenda, and touch targets grow to shop-glove size.
about.changelog.ux.context: UI string for key about.changelog.ux (WCC CMMS).

about.changelog.wo.text: Work Orders & Preventive Maintenance: Recurring schedules, reusable checklists, a calendar view, and overdue detection that surfaces what slipped.
